book_meta.work: short stories by Guy de Maupassant and Anton Chekhov
book_meta.author: Maupassant (d. 1893) and Chekhov (d. 1904)
book_meta.status: public domain — retold from the plots, no translation used

sentences.en: Evening.

sentences.ar: التلج بينزل، تقيل، مبلول، على المصابيح، والسطوح، والخيل، والناس.
sentences.en: The snow falling, thick, wet, on the lamps, the roofs, the horses, the people.

sentences.ar: وإيونا بوتابوف، سواق عربية، أبيض من التلج زي الشبح.
sentences.en: And Iona Potapov, a cab driver, white with snow like a ghost.

sentences.ar: قاعد على مقعده، ومنحني، وما بيتحرك.
sentences.en: Sits on his box, bent, and does not move.

sentences.ar: لو وقع عليه جبل تلج، ما كان تحرك.
sentences.en: Had a whole mountain of snow fallen on him, he would not have moved.
And his little horse, white as well, standing, thinking.
Since morning they have not moved.

sentences.ar: طلعوا من الإسطبل، ووقفوا هون، وما حدا نادى.
sentences.en: They came out of the stable, stood here, and no one called.

sentences.ar: والعتمة نزلت، والمصابيح ولعت، والشارع صار مليان ناس.
sentences.en: And darkness fell, the lamps lit, and the street filled with people.
And a voice: cabby!
To Vyborg!

sentences.ar: إيونا هز حاله، والتلج وقع منه، وشاف ضابط بمعطف.
sentences.en: Iona stirred, the snow fell from him, and he saw an officer in a greatcoat.
He said: get in, sir.

sentences.ar: ومشى الحصان، وبعد شوي، الضابط صرخ: يمين!
sentences.en: And the horse set off, and after a little, the officer shouted: right!
Right!
Are you blind?

sentences.ar: وإيونا لف، وقال، وهو بيبتسم: ابني... مات هالأسبوع يا سيدي.
sentences.en: And Iona turned, and said, smiling: my son... died this week, sir.
The officer said: died?
Of what?
Iona said: a fever.
Three days in the hospital, and died.
God's will.
The officer said: good God!
Look out!
You ass!
In front of you!

sentences.ar: ونزل الضابط، وإيونا رجع لمقعده، وانحنى.
sentences.en: And the officer got out, and Iona went back to his box, and bent.
And the snow came again.

sentences.ar: وبعد ساعة، تلات شباب، اتنين طوال وواحد قصير أحدب، ركبوا، وبيصرخوا وبيضحكوا.
sentences.en: And an hour later, three young men, two tall and one short and hunchbacked, climbed in, shouting and laughing.
For twenty kopeks!
To the bridge!
Come on!

sentences.ar: وقالوا عن قبعته: قبعة شو هاي!
sentences.en: And they said of his cap: what a cap!
The worst cap in Petersburg!

sentences.ar: وإيونا ضحك، وقال: هي هي... قبعة.
sentences.en: And Iona laughed, and said: hee hee... a cap.

sentences.ar: وبعدين قال: وأنا... ابني مات هالأسبوع.
sentences.en: And then said: and me... my son died this week.
The hunchback said: we all die.
Come on!
Drive!
I am cold!

sentences.ar: وقال إيونا: مات... ولدي. زي إنه أنا اللي لازم أموت، وهو اللي مات.
sentences.en: And Iona said: died... my boy. As if I was the one who should die, and he died.
And no one heard.
They were talking about a girl.
And they got out, and laughed, and went.
And Iona stood looking after them.
And sat on his box, and the grief returned, bigger.

sentences.ar: كان بيتطلع بالناس اللي بيركضوا بالشارع.
sentences.en: He watched the people hurrying along the street.
Thousands of people.
Not one who would listen.
And his grief was huge, without limits.

sentences.ar: لو انفجر صدره وطلع الهم، كان غرق الدنيا.
sentences.en: Had his chest burst and the grief come out, it would have drowned the world.
But no one saw it.
Because it was in a small heart, under snow.

sentences.ar: وشاف بواب، ونزل، وقال له: يا صاحبي، كم الساعة؟
sentences.en: And he saw a porter, got down, and said to him: friend, what time is it?
The porter said: ten.
Move away from here!
And Iona decided to go back to the stable.
To be done.

sentences.ar: وبالإسطبل، السواقين نايمين على الأرض، وبيشخروا، والموقد دافي.
sentences.en: And at the stable, the drivers slept on the floor, snoring, the stove warm.

sentences.ar: وواحد قام يشرب مي، وإيونا قال له: يا صاحبي... ابني مات. سمعت؟ هالأسبوع.
sentences.en: And one got up for water, and Iona said to him: friend... my son died. Did you hear? This week.
And the young man drank, covered his head, and slept.
And Iona sat, and thought: he wanted to tell.

sentences.ar: كيف مرض، وكيف تعذب، وشو قال قبل ما يموت، وكيف دفنوه.
sentences.en: How he fell ill, how he suffered, what he said before he died, how they buried him.

sentences.ar: وبده يحكي عن بنته بالقرية، أنيسيا.
sentences.en: And he wanted to talk about his daughter in the village, Anisya.

sentences.ar: كل هاد لازم ينحكي، على مهل، وحدا يسمع، ويتنهد، ويبكي.
sentences.en: All of this must be told, slowly, with someone listening, sighing, weeping.
And women are better at this.

sentences.ar: حتى لو غبيات، بيبكوا من أول كلمة.
sentences.en: Even if they are foolish, they cry from the first word.
And he got up, put on his coat, and went to the horse.
The horse stood in the dark, eating hay.
And Iona said to it: eating?
Eat.

sentences.ar: ما معنا مصاري لشعير، فكول قش.
sentences.en: We have no money for oats, so eat hay.
I have grown too old for driving.
My son should have been driving.
He was a real driver.
Had he lived.

sentences.ar: وسكت، وبعدين قال: هيك يا صاحبي.
sentences.en: And was silent, and then said: so it is, friend.
Kuzma Ionitch is gone.
He said to me: goodbye.
And died.
For no reason.

sentences.ar: تخيل إنه عندك مهر، وإنت أم المهر.
sentences.en: Imagine you had a foal, and you were the foal's mother.
And the foal died.
Would you grieve?

sentences.ar: والحصان بياكل، وبيسمع، وبينفخ على إيد صاحبه.
sentences.en: And the horse eats, and listens, and breathes on its master's hand.

sentences.ar: وإيونا انجرف، وحكى له كل شي.
sentences.en: And Iona was carried away, and told it everything.
